0.0.n: Introduces the next action, linking it to what came before.

0.1.n: Pairs with から to mark the starting time.

0.2.n: Marks a starting point in time; 今から means starting now.

0.4.n: Describes the people the speaker plans to interview.

0.5.n: Links 外国人 to 方, identifying what kind of people they are.

0.6.n: Read かた here, this is a respectful alternative to 人.

0.7.n: Added to 方 to indicate multiple people.

0.8.n: Marks the people the interview is directed toward.

0.9.n: An English loanword used with をする to express conducting an interview.

0.10.n: Marks インタビュー as the activity being performed with する.

0.11.n: The て-form of する plus みます politely expresses trying an action to see how it goes.

1.0.n: The polite ましょう form of 行く invites others to join the action.

0.lit: Well then, from now, to people who are foreigners, I will try doing an interview.
0.tip: Verb て-form plus みます means trying an action, not trying hard to accomplish it.

1.tip: The ending ましょう makes a polite suggestion to do something together.
